data.change_summary: Fixed two amendments: (1) In chemistry.rs, changed CO2 K_LA computation from `(k_la_o2 * 0.91).min(1.0)` to `k_la_o2.min(1.0) * 0.91` — cap the O2 K_LA first (matching the O2 reaeration path), then apply the diffusion coefficient ratio. This preserves the physical CO2/O2 = 0.91 ratio even when raw O2 K_LA exceeds the Euler stability cap at high aeration. Extracted the computation into a new `pub fn compute_co2_kla(state)` for testability. (2) Rewrote `test_co2_kla_proportional_to_o2_kla` to call the actual `compute_co2_kla()` function instead of manually computing `k_la_o2 * 0.91` (which was a tautology). The new test verifies the ratio holds at both moderate aeration (raw K_LA < 1.0) and full aeration (raw K_LA > 1.0, where the capping bug would have been caught).

steps.description: Read chemistry.rs:550-575 and dissolved_oxygen.rs:55-80 to confirm the K_LA capping bug: CO2 used `(k_la_o2 * 0.91).min(1.0)` while O2 used `k_la.min(1.0)`, causing ratio collapse to 1.0 at high aeration
Extracted `pub fn compute_co2_kla(state: &TankState) -> f64` in chemistry.rs (lines 47-58) with correct cap-then-scale order: `k_la_o2.min(1.0) * KLA_CO2_TO_O2_RATIO`
Updated `hourly_chemistry_terms()` in chemistry.rs to call `compute_co2_kla(state)` instead of inline computation

Rewrote `test_co2_kla_proportional_to_o2_kla` in co2_exchange.rs to import and call `compute_co2_kla()`, verifying the 0.91 ratio at moderate aeration (raw K_LA < 1.0) and at full aeration (raw K_LA > 1.0 where capping matters)
Ran cargo test --test co2_exchange: 12/12 passed including the rewritten proportionality test
Ran cargo test --test chemistry (21/21) and --test dissolved_oxygen (5/5): no regressions
Ran cargo clippy -p tank_core (lib-only): only pre-existing warnings in unrelated files (shrimp.rs unused imports, biology.rs dead code)
